post.topic: Automated Client Intake for Law and Accounting Firms
post.headline: Stop wasting *billable hours* on document chasing
post.subline: Automate intake forms, ID verification, and document collection before your first client consultation.
post.caption:
Is your firm losing billable hours to manual client onboarding?

Lawyers and accountants waste precious time chasing missing tax forms, bank statements, and signed questionnaires.

An automated AI intake system sends instant WhatsApp or email reminders, securely collects files, and syncs data directly into your CRM. Your team gets fully prepped client files without lifting a finger.

Actionable tip: Map your onboarding flow today and highlight the top 3 documents that slow down your team every week.

Save this post and share it with a managing partner or accountant who needs their time back.

DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call
post.insight_note: Law and accounting practices lose significant revenue potential to manual document intake, making automated onboarding a direct fix for wasted billable hours.
